subject: Privacy impact check & BAA action items for CardioMetrics
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cardiometrics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Privacy impact check & BAA action items for CardioMetrics

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today’s call: 

Summary of what we heard
- CardioMetrics will be sending PHI to an LLM endpoint for pre-diagnostic triage (patient name, DOB, limited notes).
- Procurement and security need SOC 2 evidence + a completed security questionnaire.
- Legal has asked about our BAA posture and which deployment modes we support for PHI.

Redwood posture (short):
- BAA: Available — we can execute a BAA for Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private deployments (VPC or on-prem).
- PHI eligibility: Dedicated and Private deployments are eligible for PHI processing. Our multi-tenant (hosted/shared) API is not approved for PHI unless a custom enterprise arrangement is reached and documented.
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II program; we can provide the report under NDA.

Action items / ask of CardioMetrics
1) Please upload the CardioMetrics Security Questionnaire (procurement), or we can accept a single consolidated PDF — I flagged this to your procurement team on the call.
2) Confirm expected retention window and whether de-identification is required at source.
3) Share network requirements (allowed CIDRs/IPs) if you plan a VPC/Dedicated setup so we can draft an infra diagram.

Our next steps on Redwood side
- Send our BAA template and a high-level infra diagram for Dedicated/VPC by EOD tomorrow.
- Marcus (SE) to draft answers to the questionnaire and provide a technical Q/A.
- Jordan (privacy) and Naomi (legal) to review BAA redlines if any.

Timelines
- We aim to return a completed questionnaire + infra diagram within 2 business days after receiving the questionnaire.
- BAA / commercial negotiation cadence: typically 7–14 business days depending on redlines.

If that aligns, I’ll send the questionnaire link and attach the BAA template.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

--
